checks: 18 selected tests twice debug/twice release; seven compiled mutants and restored positives
cost: Product trees O(n) big multiplies/O(log n) recursion; binomial O(min(k,n-k)) nonnegative case after guards. StirlingII O(nk)/O(k) storage, I/Bell O(n²)/O(n). Pentagonal O(n sqrt n)/O(n); coin/distinct O(n²)/O(n), partitions_k O(nk) time/space. Fibonacci O(log n) growing-width steps, derangements O(n). Legendre sieve O(n log log n) plus exponentiation, bit costs additional.
description: factorial uses balanced range products with empty product1; binomial applies negative-k zero and C(n,k)=(-1)^k C(k-n-1,k) for negative n, then product ratios. Legendre checks use nt sieve. Stirling II descends j with j*S(i-1,j)+S(i-1,j-1), I uses (i-1)*c(i-1,j)+c(i-1,j-1). Bell triangle, signed pentagonal partitions, coin DP, descending distinct/ascending odd-part counts, derangements seeds(1,0), and Fibonacci doubling (a(2b-a),a²+b²) produce Z values with alternate checks.

inverse: A Z count has many compatible function/index antecedents: 0!=1!=1, D0=D2=1. Known function and admitted domain constrain recurrence fibers but generally do not invert uniquely. Cassini alone admits more pairs than intended Fibonacci values; unavailable checks impose no value constraint.
